tests.name: bare_physics_cannot_detect_hidden_consent
tests.note: Equal physical inputs force equal classifier output when consent is not an input.

tests.name: voluntary_and_coercive_are_disjoint
tests.note: Frozen consent definitions forbid overlap of voluntary and coercive coupling.

tests.name: active_coupling_is_exhaustively_classified
tests.note: Boolean consent makes active coupling either voluntary or coercive.

tests.name: consent_gate_blocks_effective_coupling
tests.note: The declared multiplicative gate makes absent consent annihilate effective coupling.

tests.name: binding_alone_admits_coercion
tests.note: A weakened predicate equal to active binding accepts a coercive model.

tests.name: omitting_identity_admits_assimilation
tests.model:
[l_coupling = 1,
 l_consent_a = True,
 l_identity_preserved = False,
 l_consent_b = True,
 l_delta_b = 1,
 l_delta_a = 1,
 l_generative = True]
tests.note: All retained conditions can hold while identity preservation is false.

tests.name: omitting_flourishing_admits_exploitation
tests.model:
[l_coupling = 1,
 l_consent_a = True,
 l_identity_preserved = True,
 l_consent_b = True,
 l_delta_a = -1,
 l_generative = True]
tests.note: All retained conditions can hold while one participant is harmed.

tests.name: generativity_is_independent
tests.model:
[l_coupling = 1,
 l_consent_a = True,
 l_generative = False,
 l_consent_b = True,
 l_delta_b = 1,
 l_delta_a = 1,
 l_identity_preserved = True]
tests.note: Generativity is not entailed by consent, identity, and flourishing alone.

 l_fruit_3 = 0,
 l_fruit_8 = 0,
 l_fruit_6 = 1,
 l_fruit_7 = 0,
 l_fruit_0 = 0,

tests.name: local_stability_and_global_invariance_are_independent_slots
tests.note: Conserved energy can remain fixed while local curvature varies across admissible systems.

tests.name: effective_cornell_stationary_witness_exists
tests.note: A fully rational positive stationary-radius witness exists.

tests.name: effective_cornell_positive_stationary_radius_is_unique
tests.note: Strict monotonicity of k*r^3+alpha*r forbids two positive roots.

tests.name: effective_cornell_stationary_curvature_is_positive
tests.note: At stationarity the numerator equals alpha*r+3*k*r^3, which is positive.

interpretation: Passing validates expected consequences and countermodels of the frozen candidate encoding; it does not prove a theological isomorphism.
